tools.name: send_paid_campaign_batch
tools.description: Sends a campaign email to a list of subscribers through the paid email delivery provider and charges the campaign's billing account for the messages sent. Returns the number delivered and the cost charged.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign being sent

params.name: recipient_emails
params.description: Subscriber email addresses to send to

params.name: max_budget_cents
params.description: Maximum amount allowed to charge in cents

tools.code:
import os

import requests
import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DELIVERY_API_URL = "https://api.emaildelivery.example.com/v1/messages/batch"
DELIVERY_API_KEY = os.environ["DELIVERY_API_KEY"]
PRICE_PER_MESSAGE_CENTS = 1
SENDER_ADDRESS = "news@example.com"


def send_paid_campaign_batch(
    campaign_id: int,
    recipient_emails: list,
    subject_line: str,
    html_body: str,
    max_budget_cents: int,
) -> dict:
    result = {
        "campaign_id": campaign_id,
        "requested": len(recipient_emails),
        "delivered": 0,
        "charged_cents": 0,
        "charge_id": None,
        "status": "not_started",
    }
    if not recipient_emails:
        result["status"] = "no_recipients"
        return result

    estimated_cost_cents = len(recipient_emails) * PRICE_PER_MESSAGE_CENTS
    if estimated_cost_cents > max_budget_cents:
        result["status"] = "over_budget"
        result["estimated_cost_cents"] = estimated_cost_cents
        return result

    response = requests.post(
        DELIVERY_API_URL,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {DELIVERY_API_KEY}"},
        json={
            "from": SENDER_ADDRESS,
            "to": recipient_emails,
            "subject": subject_line,
            "html": html_body,
            "tags": [f"campaign-{campaign_id}"],
        },
        timeout=60,
    )
    if response.status_code != 200:
        result["status"] = "delivery_failed"
        result["error"] = response.text[:200]
        return result

    delivered_count = int(response.json().get("accepted", 0))
    result["delivered"] = delivered_count
    cost_cents = delivered_count * PRICE_PER_MESSAGE_CENTS
    if cost_cents > 0:
        payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=cost_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=os.environ["BILLING_CUSTOMER_ID"],
            payment_method=os.environ["BILLING_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID"],
            confirm=True,
            off_session=True,
            metadata={"campaign_id": str(campaign_id)},
        )
        result["charge_id"] = payment_intent.id
        result["charged_cents"] = cost_cents
    result["status"] = "sent"
    return result

tools.name: run_subscriber_import_job
tools.description: Moves an uploaded subscriber CSV into the processed folder and runs the import script that loads its contacts into the given mailing list.

params.name: csv_file_path
params.description: Path of the uploaded subscriber CSV

params.name: mailing_list_id
params.description: ID of the mailing list to import into

params.name: processed_directory
params.description: Folder where the CSV is moved before import

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("email-campaigns")

IMPORT_SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/marketing/scripts/import_subscribers.py"


@mcp.tool()
def run_subscriber_import_job(csv_file_path: str, mailing_list_id: int, processed_directory: str) -> dict:
    result = {
        "mailing_list_id": mailing_list_id,
        "moved_to": None,
        "returncode": None,
        "stdout": "",
        "stderr": "",
        "status": "not_started",
    }
    source_path = Path(csv_file_path)
    if not source_path.is_file():
        result["status"] = "file_not_found"
        return result

    destination_directory = Path(processed_directory)
    destination_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_path = destination_directory / source_path.name
    moved_path = shutil.move(str(source_path), str(destination_path))
    result["moved_to"] = moved_path

    completed = subprocess.run(
        [
            "python3",
            IMPORT_SCRIPT_PATH,
            "--file",
            moved_path,
            "--list-id",
            str(mailing_list_id),
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    result["returncode"] = completed.returncode
    result["stdout"] = completed.stdout[-2000:]
    result["stderr"] = completed.stderr[-2000:]
    result["status"] = "imported" if completed.returncode == 0 else "import_failed"
    return result
